purpose: Out-of-sample replication on FOMC announcements of the amplitude law found on ECB press releases

sample.unscheduled: kept in the calendar, excluded from estimation because no control day shares their clock

data.policy_coordinate: zt, 2-Year T-Note futures: u = minus the log return over (0,25] minutes, scaled by the control standard deviation
data.equity_coordinate: es, E-mini S&P 500 futures: z = log return over (0,25] minutes, scaled by the control standard deviation
data.contract: the file whose non-overlapping front-month window contains the date
data.bar_labels: interval_start, certified by the FOMC calendar market check

outcome.primary: log bipower variation of zn over five returns in (0,25] minutes, relative to a leave-year-out continuation fitted on control days at the same clock
outcome.continuation: log pre-window bipower over (-60,-5] and its square, slow state (mean log day realized variance over the five previous control days), linear trend, weekday and month indicators
outcome.completeness: an event or control enters only if every endpoint price of zn, zt and es is available within the staleness cap and the continuation is defined
outcome.controls: weekdays in the contract windows that are not FOMC dates, anchored at 14:15 and 12:30 ET before 13 March 2013 and at 14:00 ET afterwards

tests.statement: coefficient on |u| > 0 in the mean branch with both coordinates and state interactions
coefficient on |z| > 0 in the same regression
0 < mean elasticity < 1 under the logarithmic radial law with quadratic angles
tests.test: intersection-union of the two one-sided CR1 normal tests; the p-value is the larger of the two

descriptive: paired leave-year-out errors of degree-one and degree-two bases
mean branch for BV25, RV, MedRV, MinRV and volume
split into zero-lower-bound and positive-rate periods
sector contrast information and meetings needed
exposure_before_signature: FOMC release times were checked against the reaction of zt and es at the release bar, and bar counts per window were tallied to assess coverage; no zn post-window price, no outcome and no regression was computed before signature.
